name: Honeylovelove
source:
Love as soft as meringue. Love as sweet as honey. 

Het*lia characters star in an otome romance sim game. 
Starring Gilbert, Ludwig, Alfred in the Mentz tea shop under manager Arthur, with mysterious young man Antonio. 
Plus Honda, Feliciano, Sadiq.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE107493.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
像蛋白霜一样轻柔的爱，像蜂蜜一样甜蜜的爱。

一款由《黑塔利亚》角色出演的乙女恋爱模拟游戏。
基尔伯特、路德维希和阿尔弗雷德在亚瑟管理的门茨茶馆登场，还有神秘青年安东尼奥。
本田、费里西安诺和赛迪克也会出现。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE107493.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
